description: Attention categories of a task and their reason codes (ADR-076, 03-api.md section 4.6.0; KOR-39). Every task has one attention record (category, reason). order: since_asc = longest waiting first (since ASC, task_id ASC), since_desc = newest first (since DESC, task_id DESC). The list of reasons is closed per release; a later package may add reasons (additive, ADR-027 section 3), and a client shows an unknown reason with the generic text of its category. Derivation: ADR-076 section 2 (normative).
